# Ur's Whimsy — Revival Plan

## Core Loop
Players explore interconnected 2D side-scrolling streets across the whimsical world of Ur (`Beau's Home Street`, `Chego Chase in Andra`, `Andra Bureaucratic Hall`, `Bongul Beat in Andra`, and `Goli Grabs in Kalavana`), walking and leaping with a floaty low-gravity jump onto branches, rocky ledges, and crooked house rooftops while collecting floating stat orbs (`+XP`, `+Currants`, `+Mood`, `+Energy`). Clicking any world object, creature, NPC, or inventory slot opens a responsive context-sensitive verb menu (`Mine`, `Water`, `Pet`, `Squeeze`, `Talk to`, `Donate to`, `Drink`, `Taste`, `Race`, `Bestow`, `High five`, `Hug`, `Follow`) that spends Energy or uses items to harvest resources (Chunks of Beryl, Planks, Cherries, Bubbles, Milk, Grain, Beans), raise Mood (which boosts the iMG/XP multiplier), earn Currants and Giant Favor at Shrines, complete Magic Rock quests, train skills in real time, and trigger shared multiplayer spectacles (cooperative Beryl mining with bonus yields, follow-train conga lines, synchronized Pumpkin Ale dances, Random Kindness rainbows, Sparkle Powder star showers, and Cubimal races).

## What Made the Original Fun
1. **Immediate tactile joy & floaty platforming**: Bouncy walking, expressive oversized-head cartoon avatars (`Glitchen`), and weightless jumping across tree canopies, crooked multi-story roofs, and savannah ledges with floating stat orbs waiting along every jump arc.
2. **Surreal point-and-click verbs**: Every object answers with unexpected, humorous verbs—squeezing chickens for Mood, massaging butterflies with lotion (or tasting the lotion yourself), waiting 10 seconds in an orange plastic chair for frog bureaucrats, winding up Cubimals to race measured in planks, and consulting a talking Magic Rock.
3. **Cozy cooperative magic**: Everything is better with another player nearby—mining a Beryl Rock together spawns dual pickaxe thought bubbles and drops bonus Beryl chunks, waving matching daily `hi` signs (`Bats!`) gives stacked Mood buffs, and party consumables transform the whole street's music and animations.
4. **Distinctive underground-art UI & biomes**: The iconic rounded browser-frame HUD (top-left Mood circle, Energy bar, iMG/XP bar, top bar with Cultivate/World Map/Skill Rock, right-hand Local Chat & People Here sidebar, and bottom 16-slot inventory bar) framing deeply atmospheric multi-layer parallax streets with custom synthesized acoustic/ambient soundtracks.

## Ordered Feature List

### First 60 Seconds (Immediate Hook & Core Feel)
1. **Instant Entry & Floaty Movement**: Single key/click from a brief welcome banner drops the player straight onto `Beau's Home Street` (or direct active play with a lightweight dismissible title overlay). Responsive `A/D` or `ArrowLeft/ArrowRight` walking with hand-tuned acceleration/friction, `W`/`Space`/`ArrowUp` floaty jump with coyote time and jump buffering, squash-and-stretch, footstep dust, and smooth look-ahead camera with multi-layer parallax.
2. **Immediate First-Minute Reward**: Floating stat orbs (`+iMG`, `+Energy`, `+Mood`, `+Currants`) hover above the house steps, tree branches, and ledges; the Magic Rock right beside spawn greets the player with a speech bubble and an immediate 1-step starter quest (`Squeeze a Chicken or Harvest a Tree / Mine the Beryl Rock`) that rewards a celebratory Giant Favor visitation mask, XP burst, and party items within the first 30–45 seconds.
3. **Point-and-Click Verb Popups**: Hovering any interactive node, NPC, player, or inventory slot shows a cyan highlight glow (`#4cc3d9`) and tooltip; clicking opens a crisp speech-bubble verb menu with energy costs, progress wheel, thought-bubble tool animations, and arcing item drops into the bottom 16-slot inventory bar.

### World & Streets (All 5 Spec Areas + World Map)
4. **Beau's Home Street**: Crooked multi-story teal/purple "House of Whimsy" with climbable roof ledges, talking Magic Rock (Quests + Street Style toggle between dark `Lost Woods` and snowy `Vam Road` for 190 Energy), Butler Roy (visitor log, pose toggle, daily gift), Beryl Rock (cooperative mining), Fruit Tree, Paper/Bubble Tree, 3 Wood Trees (climbable plank branches), and Tower construction project.
5. **Chego Chase in Andra**: Savannah grassland with tan/ochre terrain, stepped stone pyramid (`Bureau of Administrative Affairs` door), Shrine to Grendaline (Favor donations), gnarled climbable tree, dirt pile, roaming butterflies, and signposts to `Bongul Beat` and `Home Street`.
6. **Andra Bureaucratic Hall (Interior)**: Beige office room with front desk, Water Cooler (`Get water from` -> `Cup of Water` -> `Drink`), orange waiting-room chairs with the 10-second standstill timer, and frog bureaucrats (`Director Wigglesbottom`, `Magister Piksnikson`) selling the `Card-Carrying Qualification` (`50 currants`).
7. **Bongul Beat in Andra**: Tiered savannah dirt ledges, Shrine to Humbaba, Animal Goods Vendor Street Spirit (Buy/Sell shop modal), Cherry Tree, roaming Chickens (`Squeeze`), Piggy (`Pet`/`Nibbles`), Butterflies (`Massage`/`Milk`), dirt piles, and signpost to `Goli Grabs`.
8. **Goli Grabs in Kalavana**: Earthy underground cavern street with rocky ledges, overhead bridge, Shrine to Lem, bubbling Cauldron (`Brew`/`Stir`), Beryl Rock, and Kitchen Tools Vendor Street Spirit.
9. **World Map & Signpost Transitions**: Clicking signposts or doors plays a brief charming `"Entering [Street] in [Region]... recalculating splines..."` transition; clicking `World Map` in the top bar opens the illustrated Ur map (`Zhambu`, `Andra`, `Kalavana`, `Home Street`) for instant teleportation.

### Systems, Progression & Multiplayer
10. **HUD & Character Windows**: Top-left Avatar Portrait with circular Mood gauge (`0-100%`), Energy progress bar, iMG/XP bar & Level badge, and collapsible left nav menu; bottom Currants counter + 16-slot inventory bar + search filter + Furniture/Cultivate placement mode; modals for **Skills** (7 categories, real-time training bar, Brain Capacity penalty indicator), **Wardrobe/Vanity** (live avatar hair, hat, shirt, pants, skin/color customization), **Quests & Badges**, and **Vendor Shop**.
11. **Rich Items & Party Spectacles**: Starting and craftable/buyable items across the 16 slots—`Pickaxe`, `Watering Can`, `Shovel`, `Butterfly Lotion` (`Taste` / `Use`), `Cup of Water`, `Pumpkin Ale` (`+29 Mood` + synchronized Thriller dance), `Random Kindness` (rainbow arc over target player), `Sparkle Powder` (star shower), `Musicblock` (plays special synth track), `Cubimal` (wind-up race in planks), `12-sided Die` (broadcasts roll in chat), and `Shrinking/Embiggening Tonic` (scales avatar size).
12. **Multiplayer Co-op & Social**: Real-time player sync (`public/net.js`) across streets, overhead speech bubbles, right-hand `Local Chat / Activity` & `People Here` list, clicking other players for `High five` (`+30 Mood`), `Hug` (`+2 Mood`), `Follow` (conga line), `Give`, and `Bestow` (Random Kindness), number keys `1-5` for emotes (Key `5` waves daily `hi sign` e.g. `Bats!` for matching bonus), and cooperative Beryl Rock mining (`Help mine` for bonus chunks).
13. **WebAudio Synthesizer**: Procedural sound effects for footsteps, floaty jump, land, verb menu pop, pickaxe clink, tree rustle/water splash, chicken squeeze squawk, orb chime, quest fanfare, Giant voice chord, and looping biome-specific background music (plucked eerie strings in `Lost Woods`, upbeat marimba/bells in `Vam Road`, warm acoustic guitar arpeggios in `Andra`, resonant cavern pads in `Kalavana`, plus `Pumpkin Ale` funk beat and `Musicblock` melody).
